groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.source_quote: SUST | SUST Electives [Courses from the specified elective list. Students may use at most one course from the same course groups of CENG 4720 / CIVL 4430 / ENVR 3210 / OCES 4203; CIVL 1190 / ENVR 1170 and COMP 1021 / COMP 1023 to count towards this elective requirement. (Students opting for EMIA 4990 are required to take a minimum of 15 credits; while those opting for EMIA 4991 a minimum of 12 credits.) Out of the electives taken, at least 6 credits should be at 3000-level or above.] | 12-15
